ticket.title: Report an incident
ticket.subtitle: Tell us what broke, with steps, URLs, and screenshots if you have them. The team gets it right away.

next.title: What happens next
next.ack: We confirm by email as soon as it is filed.
next.queue: The ticket is queued as pending and the team gets an alert.
next.follow: We write back if we need more context to fix it.

status.submittedMsg: We have received your report. The team already has it as a pending item.
status.submittedHint: Check your inbox. If it does not arrive in a few minutes, look in spam.

hints.attachments: Images or documents. Up to 5 files, 10 MB each.
hints.textarea: What you expected, what happened, steps to reproduce, screenshots/URLs…
